directives.name: include
directives.description: Directs the executor to include this field or fragment only when the `if` argument is true.

directives.name: skip
directives.description: Directs the executor to skip this field or fragment when the `if` argument is true.

directives.name: deprecated
directives.description: Marks an element of a GraphQL schema as no longer supported.

args.name: reason
args.description: Explains why this element was deprecated, usually also including a suggestion for how to access supported similar data. Formatted using the Markdown syntax, as specified by [CommonMark](https://commonmark.org/).

directives.name: specifiedBy
directives.description: Exposes a URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.

args.name: url
args.description: The URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.

directives.name: oneOf
directives.description: Indicates exactly one field must be supplied and this field must not be `null`.

types.name: Account
types.description:
Address-keyed account record. The thin replacement for the Prisma-leaked
`User` type — exposes only the fields the public API actually needs (today,
that's referral-graph data). When address-keyed metadata that doesn't fit
elsewhere shows up (display name, avatar, settings), it can grow here
without renaming.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Canonical Ethereum wallet address.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When this account first appeared in the database.

fields.name: refCodeHash
fields.description:
keccak256(utf8(trimmed_lowercase_code)) of the user's referral code, if
they own one. 0x-prefixed hex.

fields.name: maxReferrals
fields.description:
Maximum number of referrals this account's code allows. Default is 0,
so codes are not usable until explicitly configured.

fields.name: referredBy
fields.description: The account that referred this one (via their referral code), if any.

fields.name: referredByCode
fields.description: The referral code this account was referred by, if any.

fields.name: referrals
fields.description: Accounts referred by this account (via this account's referral code).

types.name: AccountAccuracyLeaderboardEntry
types.description:
One row of the accuracy leaderboard — an address with its lifetime
accuracy score aggregated across every scored attestation. Parallel
to `AccountStatsLeaderboardEntry`.

types.name: AccountAccuracyLeaderboardPage
types.description: Paginated wrapper around `AccountAccuracyLeaderboardEntry` rows with a server-truth hasMore flag.

fields.name: totalCount
fields.description: Eagerly populated: derived from the in-memory leaderboard array.

types.name: AccountAccuracyRank
types.description:
Accuracy rank and lifetime score for a single address. Mirrors
`AccountStatsRank`'s shape (`address`, the metric (`accuracyScore`),
`rank` 1-indexed and null when unranked) plus `totalForecasters` — the
size of the scored-forecaster set. Named specifically vs the generic
`AccountStatsRank.totalParticipants` because this surface only ranks
forecasters; accuracy is lifetime-aggregated (the time-weighted error
already weights by recency) so there's no window filter.

types.name: AccountConnection
types.description:
Relay-shaped connection over `Account` rows (User table). Address-only
synthetic accounts are not returned — those are reachable through
`account(address:)` directly. `totalCount` is the row count matching the
filter (cheap — the User table is small).

types.name: AccountFilter
types.description:
Filter input for `accountsConnection`. Intentionally narrow — the only
meaningful filter dimension for an address-keyed table is substring
match against the address itself.

inputFields.name: search
inputFields.description:
Substring search against the wallet address (case-insensitive). Useful
for autocomplete / lookup UIs.

types.name: AccountStat
types.description:
One row of the per-account stats time series — wallet collateral
position, settlement PnL, trade volume, and prediction outcome counts
at a single snapshot boundary. Mirrors the fat-row pattern used by
`ProtocolStat` / `VaultStat`: per-bucket deltas use the `period…`
prefix, cumulative-through-bucket values use the `cumulative…` prefix.
Wei amounts are 18-decimal decimal strings; counts are integers.

Today this is assembled on-demand from the same SQL helpers that back
the deprecated `accountBalance` / `accountPnl` / `accountPredictionCount` /
`accountVolume` resolvers, projected to a fixed daily cadence. A
follow-up will introduce a real per-account snapshot table and swap
the resolver to read from it — the wire shape is the destination, so
clients are forward-compatible across that swap.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Snapshot boundary.

fields.name: periodPnL
fields.description: Realized PnL delta over this bucket (wei, 18 dec)

fields.name: cumulativePnL
fields.description: Running cumulative realized PnL through this bucket (wei, 18 dec)

fields.name: periodVolume
fields.description: Trade volume delta over this bucket (wei, 18 dec)

fields.name: cumulativeVolume
fields.description: Running cumulative trade volume through this bucket (wei, 18 dec)

fields.name: deployedCollateral
fields.description: Active collateral in open positions at this bucket (wei, 18 dec)

fields.name: claimableCollateral
fields.description: Collateral available to claim from settled positions at this bucket (wei, 18 dec)

fields.name: predictionsTotal
fields.description: Predictions opened in this bucket, total

fields.name: predictionsWon
fields.description: Predictions won (settled in caller's favour) in this bucket

fields.name: predictionsLost
fields.description: Predictions lost in this bucket

fields.name: predictionsPending
fields.description: Predictions still pending at the bucket boundary

fields.name: predictionsNonDecisive
fields.description: Predictions settled non-decisively in this bucket

types.name: AccountStatsFilters
types.description:
Filters for `accountStatsLeaderboardPage` and `accountStatsRank`. All fields
are optional: omit the input entirely to rank by `NET_PNL` over all time.
`from` omitted ⇒ no lower bound (all-time); `to` omitted ⇒ now. Both bounds
are inclusive.

types.name: AccountStatsLeaderboardEntry
types.description:
One row of the account-stats leaderboard — an address with its net PnL,
gross gains, gross losses, and trading volume over a window. All amounts
are wei strings (18 decimals); `losses` is negative.

types.name: AccountStatsLeaderboardPage
types.description: Paginated wrapper around `AccountStatsLeaderboardEntry` rows with a server-truth hasMore flag.

fields.name: totalCount
fields.description: Eagerly populated: derived from the in-memory merged-stats array.

types.name: AccountStatsMetric
types.description: Metric an account-stats leaderboard is ranked by.

types.name: AccountStatsRank
types.description:
Stats + rank for a single address against the same ranked set the
leaderboard slices. Stat fields mirror `AccountStatsLeaderboardEntry` and
are always populated (zero when the address has no activity in the window).
`rank` is 1-indexed against the ranked set for the chosen metric, or null
when the address is absent from it. `totalParticipants` is the size of the
ranked set in the window (0 when the window has no participants at all,
distinguishing an empty-window stub from an unranked address in a
populated window).

types.name: ActivityFilter
types.description:
Filter input for the Relay-shaped `activity(...)` connection. Combines
with AND. `types: []` is an explicit zero-result query — omit `types`
to include both predictions and trades.

inputFields.name: account
inputFields.description:
Restrict to a single account's activity (case-insensitive). OR-across
prediction roles (predictor / counterparty) and trade sides (buyer /
seller). Omit for a global feed.

inputFields.name: conditionId
inputFields.description:
Restrict to activity on a single condition. Walks Pick → PickConfiguration
to derive the matching pickConfigIds (predictions) and predictor /
counterparty tokens (trades).

inputFields.name: conditionIds
inputFields.description:
Restrict to activity on any of these conditions. Union with `conditionId`
when both are supplied; useful for group-backed feeds where the caller
has the condition list pre-resolved.

inputFields.name: conditionGroupId
inputFields.description:
Restrict to activity reachable through a ConditionGroup's member conditions.
Expanded server-side into the group's condition ids, then treated as
`conditionIds`.

inputFields.name: pickConfigId
inputFields.description:
Restrict to activity tied to a single pick configuration. When combined
with `conditionId`/`conditionIds`, intersects with that condition's
pickConfig set.

inputFields.name: types
inputFields.description:
Restrict to one or both ActivityType union members. `[]` is an explicit
zero-result query.

inputFields.name: createdAt
inputFields.description:
Filter by activity row creation epoch seconds, e.g. `{ gte: 1770000000 }`.
Applied as `createdAt` on Predictions (Postgres timestamp) and
`executedAt` on Trades (Int seconds) — bounds project to each side's
native column type.

types.name: ActivityFilters
types.description:
Flat filter input for the `accountActivityPage` query. Each field is
optional; values combine with AND. Omit `address` for a global feed.

inputFields.name: address
inputFields.description: Restrict to a single account's activity (case-insensitive). Omit for a global feed.

inputFields.name: conditionId
inputFields.description: Restrict to activity on a single condition.

inputFields.name: pickConfigId
inputFields.description: Restrict to activity tied to a single pick configuration.

inputFields.name: type
inputFields.description: Restrict to just prediction events or just trade events. Omit for both.

types.description: A single activity entry — either a prediction or a trade, sorted by timestamp

fields.description: Unix seconds timestamp for sorting.

types.name: ActivityItemType

types.name: ActivityTrade
types.description: Trade fields embedded in an activity item

types.name: Address
types.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase 20-byte Ethereum address. Mixed-case checksum input is accepted and normalized to lowercase.

fields.name: forecast
fields.description:
Raw forecast value as recorded on-chain — the `uint256 forecast` field
on the EAS attestation schema, returned as a decimal string in D18
fixed-point representing a probability in `[0, 1e18]`. For the
canonical normalized probability use `Attestation.attestationScore.probabilityFloat`
(0–1 float) or `Attestation.attestationScore.probabilityD18`
(18-decimal fixed-point string).

fields.name: attestedAt
fields.description:
When the attestation was made on-chain. Replaces the legacy `time`
field — same value, the new name follows the `*At` event-timestamp
convention used elsewhere in the schema.

fields.name: time
fields.deprecationReason: Use `attestedAt` — same value, name follows the `*At` event-timestamp convention.

types.description: Legacy flat filter input for removed offset-page condition group access.

inputFields.name: ids
inputFields.description: Restrict to these condition group IDs.

inputFields.name: search
inputFields.description: Free-text search across the group's `name` (case-insensitive).

inputFields.name: categorySlugs
inputFields.description: Restrict to groups whose category slug is in this set.

inputFields.description:
Restrict to groups that have at least one Condition on this chain.
Implemented as a `conditions: { some: { chainId: $chainId } }` filter, so
groups whose conditions live on other chains drop out of the page.

inputFields.name: publicOnly
inputFields.description:
When true, restrict to groups that have at least one *public* Condition.
Defaults to false — matches the deprecated bare-array surface, which had
no visibility filter on the group itself.

inputFields.name: includeEmpty
inputFields.description:
When false (default), groups with no Conditions are filtered out — this
matches what every UI consumer wants. When true, empty groups are

types.name: ConditionGroupOrder
types.description: Order input for the Relay-shaped `conditionGroups` connection.

types.name: ConditionGroupOrderField
types.description:
Sort fields for the Relay-shaped `conditionGroups` connection. Mirrors
the Condition enum value names; the resolver maps each to the
group-level denormalized aggregate column (`maxCreatedAtEpoch`,
`maxEndTime`, `totalPredictionCount`, `totalSimilarMarketVolume24h`,
`totalSimilarMarketVolume7d`).

`OPEN_INTEREST` is intentionally omitted — symmetric with
`ConditionOrderField` above. The `totalOpenInterest` column is
Decimal (not varchar), so the numeric-sort issue doesn't apply at the
group level — but listing `OPEN_INTEREST` on `ConditionGroupOrderField`
without listing it on `ConditionOrderField` would be confusingly
asymmetric, so we hold both back together.

types.name: ConditionGroupSortField
types.description: Legacy condition-group offset sort fields retained only for generated compatibility.

types.name: ConditionOrConditionGroup
types.description:
Discriminated union over the two backing entities a `Question` can wrap.
Clients use fragment spreads on `Condition` and `ConditionGroup` to read
fields specific to each branch.

types.name: ConditionOrder
types.description: Order input for the Relay-shaped `conditions` connection.

types.name: ConditionOrderField
types.description:
Sort fields for the Relay-shaped `conditions` connection. All values
map to existing partial indexes on the `condition` table:

- `CREATED_AT` → `IDX_condition_public_createdat`
- `RESOLVES_AT` → `IDX_condition_public_endtime` (column: `endTime`)
- `PREDICTION_COUNT` → `IDX_condition_prediction_count`
- `SIMILAR_MARKET_VOLUME_24H` → `IDX_condition_public_volume24h`
- `SIMILAR_MARKET_VOLUME_7D` → `IDX_condition_public_volume7d`

`OPEN_INTEREST` is intentionally omitted. The underlying
`Condition.openInterest` column is varchar; the partial index
`IDX_condition_oi_numeric` is on the `::numeric` cast expression, so
typed Prisma `orderBy` would sort lexicographically (`"9" > "1000"`)
and miss the index. Lands together with raw-SQL numeric sort in a
follow-up — additive, non-breaking.

types.name: ConditionOutcome
types.description:
Resolved state of a `Condition`. `YES` and `NO` are decisive resolutions
of the binary outcome; `NON_DECISIVE` covers voided / tied / unresolvable
settlements (which the protocol collapses to `COUNTERPARTY_WINS` at the
Prediction layer). Nullable on the wire — `null` means "not yet settled."

Derived at the resolver from `settled` / `resolvedToYes` / `nonDecisive`
columns; clients should filter "settled" via `outcome: { isNull: false }`
rather than depending on the legacy boolean fields.

types.name: ConditionOutcomeFilter
types.description:
Operator-pattern filter for `ConditionOutcome` enum. `{ isNull: true }`
selects unsettled conditions; `{ isNull: false }` selects settled
(any outcome). `{ equals: NON_DECISIVE }` selects voided/non-decisive
settlements specifically. See `ConditionOutcome`.

types.name: ConditionVisibility

types.name: DateTime

types.name: DateTimeISO
types.description: A date-time string at UTC, such as 2007-12-03T10:15:30Z, compliant with the `date-time` format outlined in section 5.6 of the RFC 3339 profile of the ISO 8601 standard for representation of dates and times using the Gregorian calendar.This scalar is serialized to a string in ISO 8601 format and parsed from a string in ISO 8601 format.

types.name: Float

types.name: ID
types.description: The `ID` scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"4"`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.

types.name: IDFilter
types.description:
Operator-pattern filter for `ID` scalar fields. Supports equality,
membership, negation, and null. Resolvers reject unsupported operators
on a per-field basis (e.g., a non-nullable column rejects `isNull`).

types.name: Int
types.description: The `Int` scalar type represents non-fractional signed whole numeric values. Int can represent values between -(2^31) and 2^31 - 1.

types.name: LeaderboardFilter
types.description:
Filter input for `leaderboard(...)`. PNL / VOLUME / ROI aggregate over a
configurable window; ACCURACY is lifetime-aggregated (the time-weighted
Brier-derived score already weights by recency) and ignores the window.
Operator-pattern shape matches `AccountStatsFilter`.

inputFields.name: timestamp
inputFields.description:
Filter by aggregation epoch seconds. `{ gte }` sets the window's lower
bound, `{ lte }` sets the upper bound; both inclusive. Other operators
reject — this is a window selector, not a point query.

types.name: Node
types.description:
Relay-style identifiable object. Types that implement `Node` carry a
globally unique opaque `id` and are refetchable through the root
`node(id:)` / `nodes(ids:)` fields. Domain identifiers (predictionId,
hash, uid, address) remain on the entity as separate fields; `id` is a
second identity layer used for cache normalization and polymorphic
refetch.

fields.name: id
fields.description:
Opaque, globally unique identifier. Clients should treat this as a
refetch token only — do not parse, mint, or compare it to domain ids.
Stable for the lifetime of the entity it identifies.

types.name: OrderDirection
types.description: Sort order shared across every `orderBy` input on the redesigned surface.

types.name: Page
types.description:
Shared shape for `*Page` paginated wrappers. Concrete types add their own
strongly-typed `items` field; `hasMore` and `totalCount` live here so generic
clients can read them across page types.

fields.name: hasMore
fields.description: Server-truth signal that more rows exist beyond this page. Always populated.

fields.name: totalCount
fields.description:
Total rows matching the same filters as `items`.

Lazy by default — the count query only fires when this field is selected
in the operation, so paginated requests that don't need a total don't pay
for one. Concrete `*Page` types call out the two exceptions to this:
  - **Eagerly populated**: the count is cheap (e.g. derived from the same
    in-memory array `items` was sliced from), so it's always set.
  - **May be null**: the underlying query (unions, merged feeds) cannot
    efficiently produce a stable total, so the field is null even when
    the client selects it.

types.name: PageInfo
types.description:
Cursor-based pagination metadata for Relay-style connections. Sits
alongside the legacy `Page` interface (offset/skip-based pagination)
during the API redesign; new connection types use `PageInfo`, existing
`*Page` types keep `Page`.

fields.name: hasNextPage
fields.description: True if more rows exist after `endCursor` in the current ordering.

fields.name: hasPreviousPage
fields.description: True if more rows exist before `startCursor` in the current ordering.

fields.name: startCursor
fields.description: Cursor of the first edge in the page, or null when the page is empty.

fields.name: endCursor
fields.description: Cursor of the last edge in the page, or null when the page is empty.

types.name: Position
types.description:
ERC-20 token balance representing one side of a prediction position. The
underlying Position row may surface as multiple `*Page` items: one
"open" row carrying remaining cost basis, plus one synthesized "sell"
row per secondary-market disposal (so PnL realizes incrementally).

fields.name: balance
fields.description:
Number of position tokens still held (decimal string, 18 decimals on
Sapience). Synthesized sell rows carry `"0"` here — the realized PnL
delta from that sell lives on `realizedPnL`.

fields.description: Holder wallet address (lowercase 0x-hex).

fields.name: id
fields.description:
Synthetic row id. Open rows use the underlying Position row id
serialized as a string; synthesized sell rows append `"-sell-<tradeHash>"`.

fields.name: realizedPnL
tokenAddress
fields.description: ERC-20 position token address (lowercase 0x-hex).

fields.name: totalPayout
fields.description:
Cumulative payout the contract would owe this position if every
matched prediction resolved in the holder's favour (wei, 18 dec).
Equal to the total collateral pool across the holder's matched
predictions, NOT the net profit. Null when the holder has no matched
predictions on this pickConfig.

fields.name: userCollateral
fields.description:
Cost basis remaining on the holder's open balance (wei, 18 dec). For
synthesized sell rows this is the basis allocated to the shares
disposed of, computed via running WAC. Null when there is no basis to
surface (zero-balance settled position, etc.).

fields.name: node
fields.description:
Refetch any `Node`-implementing entity by its opaque global id. Returns
`null` when the id is malformed, the type is not registered, or the
underlying entity has been deleted. Domain-id lookups (e.g.
`predictionByOnchainId`, `tradeByHash`) remain the preferred entry point
for new traffic; `node(id:)` exists so Relay-style clients can refetch
cached entities polymorphically without knowing their concrete type.

fields.name: nodes
fields.description:
Batched form of `node(id:)`. Preserves input order; each element is
resolved independently and may be null. Useful for client caches that

fields.name: accountAccuracyRank
fields.description:
Accuracy rank and lifetime score for a single address. Mirrors
`accountStatsRank`'s shape: stats fields are always populated (zero for

ranked set, and `totalForecasters` is the size of the scored-forecaster
set.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `account(address: $a).rank(metric: ACCURACY)` — returns the same rank + value via the Relay-shaped Account surface.

fields.name: accountAccuracy
fields.description:
Lifetime accuracy score for a single address, or null if no scored
attestations exist.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `accountAccuracyRank` for the rank-and-score shape, or `accuracyLeaderboardPage` for the leaderboard. `ForecasterScore`'s legacy counter fields (numScored, sumErrorSquared, …) were always returned as zeros.

fields.name: accountActivity
fields.description: Unified activity feed — predictions and trades merged by timestamp. When address is provided, scopes to that account; otherwise returns recent global activity.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `activityPage` — same data with a server-truth `hasMore` stop signal.

fields.name: activityPage
fields.description:
Unified activity feed (predictions + trades merged by timestamp), wrapped
in an `ActivityItemsPage` with a server-truth `hasMore` flag. The whole

replacement; flat-arg / `filters:`-arg variants both keep working until
the deprecation window closes.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `activity(first:, after:, filter:, orderBy:)` — Relay-shaped pagination over the same merged predictions/trades feed.

fields.name: accountActivityPage
fields.description:
Deprecated alias for `activityPage` — the `account*` prefix predates the
global-feed mode (added when `address` became optional). Kept on the
flat-arg shape; callers wanting the `filters:` input should migrate
to `activityPage`.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `activityPage` — same resolver, the name reflects that the resolver also serves the global feed when `address` is omitted.

fields.name: accountStats
fields.description:
Per-account stats time series — wallet collateral position, PnL, volume,
and prediction outcome counts across snapshots in a window. Mirrors the
`protocolStats` / `vaultStats` fat-row shape: no `interval` arg, server
picks the cadence; `fromEpoch` / `toEpoch` are optional epoch seconds
(inclusive). Both omitted ⇒ last 365 days (the DAY-bucket cap in the
helper layer until the snapshot table lands).

Implementation today wraps the legacy per-metric SQL helpers and emits
one point per day. A follow-up migrates this to a real per-account
snapshot table without changing the wire shape.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `account(address: $a).stats(filter: { timestamp: { gte: $from, lte: $to } })` — same fat-row shape via the Relay-shaped Account surface.

fields.name: accountBalance
fields.description:

positions) and claimable (settled but unredeemed). DEPRECATED: use

`claimableCollateral` per snapshot.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `accountStats` — the fat row carries `deployedCollateral` / `claimableCollateral` per snapshot.

fields.name: accountPnl
fields.description:
Time-bucketed profit-and-loss for a single address with cumulative tracking.
DEPRECATED: use `accountStats`; the fat row carries `periodPnL` /
`cumulativePnL` per snapshot.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `accountStats` — the fat row carries `periodPnL` / `cumulativePnL` per snapshot.

fields.name: accountPredictionCount
fields.description:
Time-bucketed prediction count with outcome breakdown for a single address,
bucketed by creation time. DEPRECATED: use `accountStats`; the fat row carries
`predictionsTotal` / `predictionsWon` / `predictionsLost` / `predictionsPending`
/ `predictionsNonDecisive` per snapshot.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `accountStats` — the fat row carries `predictionsTotal` / `predictionsWon` / `predictionsLost` / `predictionsPending` / `predictionsNonDecisive` per snapshot.

fields.name: accountVolume

Time-bucketed trading volume for a single address. DEPRECATED: use

fields.deprecationReason: Use `accountStatsRank(address: $a).volume` (omit `filters` for all-time).

ranked set; `totalParticipants` is the ranked-set size (0 when the
window has no participants at all — that distinguishes "empty window"

fields.deprecationReason: Use `account(address: $a).rank(metric: PNL|VOLUME|ROI, filter:)` — returns the same rank + value via the Relay-shaped Account surface.

fields.deprecationReason: Use `protocol.openInterestByCategory`.

fields.name: openInterestByTimeToResolution
fields.description: Open interest bucketed by time-to-resolution — protocol-wide. Each unsettled prediction's collateral falls into the bucket of its latest condition endTime; expired-but-pending predictions roll into the soonest bucket.

fields.name: protocolStats
fields.description:
Protocol-wide statistics time series at the configured snapshot cadence —
cumulative volume, trade count, open interest, escrow balance. Window
with `fromEpoch` / `toEpoch` (epoch seconds, inclusive). Both omitted
returns full history.

Bar timestamps: closed bars are labelled at *the start* of the interval
they represent (capture time minus one interval), so a bar at
`2026-01-01 00:00` summarizes activity ending `2026-01-02 00:00`. When
`toEpoch` covers now, a trailing live candle is appended; the live
candle's `timestamp` is the *current* interval boundary (not shifted
back), so callers can distinguish it as `points[points.length - 1]
.timestamp >= floor(now / interval) * interval`.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `protocol.stats(filter:)` — Relay-shaped stats connection under the protocol namespace.

use `protocolStats`; the fat row carries `periodVolume` / `cumulativeVolume`
per snapshot.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `protocolStats` — the fat row carries `periodVolume` / `cumulativeVolume` per snapshot.

fields.name: questions
fields.description:
Deprecated bare-array form. Retained unchanged for the one-release
deprecation window so pinned clients keep working. New callers
should use `questionsConnection(first:, after:, filter:, orderBy:)`.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `questionsConnection(first:, after:, filter:, orderBy:)` — Relay-shaped cursor pagination over the same interleaved feed.

fields.name: questionsConnection
fields.description:
Relay-shaped connection over `Question` rows — the interleaved
Condition / ConditionGroup feed. Forward-only cursor pagination via
`first` / `after`. Replaces the deprecated bare `questions(...)`. `totalCount` is omitted on
`QuestionConnection` because the underlying SQL UNION cannot produce
a single COUNT cheaply.

Note: this field will be renamed to drop the `Connection` suffix
(→ `questions`) in a subsequent migration, once the deprecated
bare-array sibling above is removed.

fields.name: trade
fields.description:
Look up a single secondary market trade by its trade hash. Pass
`tradeHash:` — the legacy `id:` arg is kept (deprecated) so existing
callers keep working through one release.

fields.name: tradeCount
fields.description: Count of secondary market trades matching the given filters
fields.deprecationReason: Use `tradesConnection` — Relay-shaped cursor pagination over the same data.

fields.name: trades
fields.description: Paginated list of secondary market trades, filterable by seller, buyer, token, and chain
fields.deprecationReason: Use `tradesConnection` — Relay-shaped cursor pagination over the same data.

fields.name: tradeByHash
fields.description: Look up a single secondary market trade by its trade hash.

fields.name: tradesConnection
fields.description:
Relay-shaped connection over secondary market trades.

Note: this field will be renamed to drop the `Connection` suffix
(→ `trades`) in a subsequent migration, once the deprecated
`trades` bare-array sibling above is removed.

fields.name: user
fields.deprecationReason: Use `account(address:)` — flat address arg, returns the same address-keyed referral data via the new public-API-shaped `Account` type. The Prisma-leaked `User` type will be removed once telemetry on this path drains.

fields.name: users
fields.deprecationReason: Unused; will be removed. No live consumers — account lookups go through `account(address:)`.

fields.name: vaultStats
fields.description:
Vault-specific statistics time series for a single vault address — vault
balance, deployed/available collateral, cumulative PnL, deposits,
withdrawals, airdrop gains, secondary flows, unredeemed claims. Window
with `fromEpoch` / `toEpoch` (epoch seconds, inclusive). Both omitted
returns full history.

Bar timestamps follow the same convention as `protocolStats`: closed
bars are labelled at the *start* of the interval they represent, and a
trailing live candle (anchored to the *current* interval boundary) is
appended when `toEpoch` covers now.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `vaultByAddress(address:).stats(filter:)` — per-vault snapshots now live on Vault.

types.name: Question
types.description:
A question — derived view that interleaves grouped and ungrouped markets.
A `Question` is **not** a durable entity (no `Node` membership, no
`question(id:)` lookup). Identity flows through the wrapped `source`
(either a `Condition` or a `ConditionGroup`), each of which already
carries its own primary key.

fields.name: source
fields.description:
The underlying entity this question wraps. Exactly one of
`Condition` | `ConditionGroup`. `__typename` discriminates between
the two; the legacy `questionType` field is the same information in
scalar form and is now `@deprecated`.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Display title forwarded from the source — `Condition.question` or `ConditionGroup.name`.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Long-form description forwarded from the source (`Condition.description`); null for groups.

fields.name: openInterest
fields.description: Open interest forwarded from the source — `Condition.openInterest` or `ConditionGroup.totalOpenInterest`.

fields.name: volume
fields.description: 24h similar-market volume forwarded from the source.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Creation timestamp forwarded from the source.

fields.name: resolvesAt
fields.description: Resolution time forwarded from the source — `Condition.endTime` or `ConditionGroup.maxEndTime`.

fields.name: condition
fields.deprecationReason: Use `source` (union over Condition | ConditionGroup).

fields.name: group
fields.deprecationReason: Use `source` (union over Condition | ConditionGroup).

fields.name: predictionCount
fields.deprecationReason: Use `source` and read `predictionCount` on the wrapped entity.

fields.name: questionType
fields.deprecationReason: Use `source.__typename`.

types.name: QuestionConnection
types.description:
Relay-shaped connection over `Question` rows. `totalCount` is
intentionally omitted — the underlying SQL UNION over `condition_group`
and ungrouped `condition` rows cannot produce a single COUNT cheaply.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Deprecated convenience alias for `nodes`; kept while repo callers migrate to the Relay shape.

fields.name: hasMore
fields.description: Deprecated convenience alias for `pageInfo.hasNextPage`.

types.name: QuestionEdge
types.description: Cursor-bearing edge for `QuestionConnection`.

types.name: QuestionFilter
types.description:
Filter input for the Relay-shaped `questions` connection. Combines
with AND. For outcome-based filtering today, use
`conditions(filter: { outcome: ... })`.

inputFields.name: chainId
inputFields.description: Restrict to a single chain. Defaults to DEFAULT_CHAIN_ID when a contract-address filter is present.

inputFields.name: contractAddress
inputFields.description: Match the on-chain contract address that owns the underlying condition (case-insensitive).

inputFields.name: contractAddressIn
inputFields.description: Match any on-chain contract address that owns the underlying condition (case-insensitive).

inputFields.name: categorySlugs
inputFields.description: Restrict to questions whose category slug is in this set.

inputFields.name: resolutionStatus
inputFields.description: Resolution-status filter; defaults to all when omitted.

inputFields.name: estimatedPrice
inputFields.description: Filter by estimated price, e.g. `{ gte: 0.2, lte: 0.8 }`.

inputFields.name: similarMarketVolume
inputFields.description: Filter by all-time or windowed similar-market volume, e.g. `{ gte: 10000 }`.

inputFields.name: similarMarketVolumeWindow
inputFields.description: Window the similar-market-volume filter and sort look at. When omitted, the all-time column is used.

inputFields.name: search
inputFields.description: Free-text search across the wrapped Condition/Group's title and description (case-insensitive).

inputFields.name: tag
inputFields.description:
Restrict to questions tagged with this value. Single-tag only at
the SDL level — the underlying union runner accepts one tag at a
time. Multi-tag (`[String!]`) will be added when the runner supports
it (additive, non-breaking).

inputFields.name: resolvesAt
inputFields.description: Filter by resolution epoch seconds, e.g. `{ gte: 1770000000 }`.

types.name: QuestionFilters
types.description:
Legacy flat filter input mirroring the inline-arg shape that the deprecated
`questions(...)` resolver kept.

inputFields.name: chainId
inputFields.description:
Restrict to a single chain. When omitted and a `contractAddress*` filter is
present, defaults to the API's `DEFAULT_CHAIN_ID` so address lookups are not
silently cross-chain.

inputFields.name: contractAddress
inputFields.description:
Match the on-chain contract address that owns the underlying condition
(case-insensitive). Maps to the DB `condition.resolver` column. Pair with
`chainId`; if omitted, `chainId` defaults to `DEFAULT_CHAIN_ID`.

inputFields.name: contractAddressIn
inputFields.description:
Match any of these on-chain contract addresses (case-insensitive). Same
semantics as `contractAddress`.

inputFields.name: search
inputFields.description: Free-text search across the group/condition's `name`, `question`, `shortName`, and `tags` (case-insensitive).

inputFields.name: categorySlugs
inputFields.description: Restrict to questions whose category slug is in this set.

inputFields.name: tag
inputFields.description: Single-tag filter (case-sensitive against the condition's `tags` array).

inputFields.name: minEndTime
inputFields.description: Restrict to conditions with `endTime >= this`.

inputFields.name: resolutionStatus
inputFields.description: Resolution-status filter; defaults to `all` when omitted.

inputFields.name: minEstimatedPrice
inputFields.description: Restrict to conditions with `estimatedPrice >= this`.

inputFields.name: maxEstimatedPrice
inputFields.description: Restrict to conditions with `estimatedPrice <= this`.

inputFields.name: minSimilarMarketVolume
inputFields.description: Restrict to conditions with similar-market volume `>= this`.

inputFields.name: maxSimilarMarketVolume
inputFields.description: Restrict to conditions with similar-market volume `<= this`.

inputFields.name: similarMarketVolumeWindow
inputFields.description:
Window the similar-market-volume filter and sort look at. When omitted,
the all-time `similarMarketVolume` column is used.

types.name: QuestionItemType
types.description: Whether a question is a group of related conditions or a single condition

types.name: QuestionOrder
types.description: Order input for the Relay-shaped `questions` connection.

types.name: QuestionOrderField
types.description:
Sort fields for the Relay-shaped `questions` connection. The runner
unions Conditions and ConditionGroups; sort values pick the column on
each side. `OPEN_INTEREST` is intentionally omitted (symmetric with
`ConditionOrderField`) — the Condition side would sort the varchar
column lexicographically; restore together with raw-SQL numeric sort
in a follow-up.

types.name: QuestionSortField
types.description: Field to sort questions by

types.name: ReferralCode
types.description:
Public referral code metadata. Exposed via `User.referredByCode` /
`Account.referredByCode` so clients can render an account's referrer.

Referral codes are low-security attribution hints: using someone else's code
only credits that referrer; it does not grant access to funds or privileged
actions. `codeHash` is intentionally omitted from GraphQL — public clients
identify codes by integer `id`. Aggregate analytics (claim count, volume,
claimants) live on the public REST endpoint `GET /referrals/codes`.

types.name: ResolutionStatus
types.description: Filter questions by their resolution status

types.name: SettlementResult
types.description: Outcome of a prediction settlement

types.name: String
types.description: The `String` scalar type represents textual data, represented as UTF-8 character sequences. The String type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.

types.name: TimeInterval
types.description: Time interval for bucketing the legacy per-account time-series resolvers.

types.name: TimeToResolutionBucket
types.description:
Open-interest aggregated by time-to-resolution bucket. Each unsettled
prediction's collateral is bucketed by the latest endTime among the conditions
it touches (the moment its OI can finally be claimed). One row per non-empty
bucket, ordered from soonest (bucket = 1) to furthest out.

fields.name: bucket
fields.description: Sort order: 1 = soonest, increasing for further-out buckets

fields.name: label
fields.description: Display label, e.g. ≤1d / 2-7d / 1-2mo

fields.name: openInterest
fields.description: Open interest in wei (decimal string)

fields.name: predictionCount
fields.description: Number of predictions contributing to this bucket

types.name: Trade
types.description:
Secondary market trade record where position tokens are exchanged
between users. The on-chain reference is `tradeHash`; `id` is an
internal row id (see schema-preamble conventions).

fields.name: buyer
fields.description: Buyer wallet address (lowercase 0x-hex).

fields.name: collateral
fields.description: Collateral asset address paid in this trade (lowercase 0x-hex).

fields.name: price
fields.description: Total collateral paid by buyer (wei, 18 dec). `price / tokenAmount` is the per-share price.

fields.name: seller
fields.description: Seller wallet address (lowercase 0x-hex).

fields.name: token
fields.description: Position token address being exchanged (lowercase 0x-hex).

fields.name: tokenAmount
fields.description: Quantity of position tokens transferred (wei, 18 dec on Sapience).

fields.name: tradeHash
fields.description: Canonical trade hash — the on-chain identifier (0x-prefixed).

types.name: TradeConnection
types.description: Relay-shaped connection over `Trade` rows.

types.name: TradeEdge
types.description: Cursor-bearing edge for `TradeConnection`.

types.name: TradeFilter
types.description: Filter input for the Relay-shaped `tradesConnection` query. Combines with AND.

inputFields.name: address
inputFields.description: Restrict to trades where the address is seller or buyer (case-insensitive). Mutually exclusive with `seller`/`buyer`.

inputFields.name: seller
inputFields.description: Restrict to a single seller address (case-insensitive).

inputFields.name: buyer
inputFields.description: Restrict to a single buyer address (case-insensitive).

inputFields.name: token
inputFields.description: Restrict to a single position token address (case-insensitive).

inputFields.name: chainId
inputFields.description: Restrict to a single chain.

inputFields.name: executedAt
inputFields.description: Filter by execution epoch seconds, e.g. `{ gte: 1770000000, lt: 1770086400 }`.

types.name: TradeOrder
types.description: Order input for the Relay-shaped `tradesConnection`.

types.name: TradeOrderField
types.description: Sort fields for the Relay-shaped `tradesConnection`.

types.name: UnixSeconds
types.description: Integer Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC). Wire format is Int; the scalar carries the unit/TZ contract in the type system rather than the field name.

types.name: User
types.description:
Application-level user record, keyed by wallet address,
used for referrals and other per-wallet metadata.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Canonical Ethereum wallet address for this user.

fields.name: maxReferrals
fields.description:
Maximum number of referrals this user's code allows. Default is 0,
so codes are not usable until explicitly configured.

fields.name: refCodeHash
fields.description: keccak256(utf8(trimmed_lowercase_code)) stored as 0x-prefixed hex.

types.name: VaultStat
types.description: Vault-specific stats snapshot for a single vault address.

fields.name: timestamp

fields.name: secondaryBought

fields.name: secondarySold
